test_title: PYST 59: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that rectifies the error(s) in the following sentence.

One must do his/her duty proparly.

options.text: One must do one’s duti proprly.
One must do ones duty properly.
One must do one's duty properly.
One must do once duty proparly.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **pronoun** should agree with the** indefinite pronoun "one"**.
 
• Therefore, the possessive form **"one's" s**hould be used instead of **"his/her".**
 
• Additionally, the word **"proparly"** is incorrectly spelled and should be corrected to** "properly".**
 
• The correct form is "One must do one's duty properly."

Hence, the correct statement should be*** 'One must do one's duty properly.***'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using** “one”** as an indefinite pronoun requires other pronouns to agree in formality.
 
• The word “**properly**” is an adverb and should be spelled correctly to maintain proper grammar in the sentence.
